title: Design System: Annuity Gator Advisor App

display-xl.purpose: Login heading (2.25rem on phones) and the desktop rail statement; DM Serif Display 400 only.

display.purpose: Auth utility page headings (AuthContainer), DM Serif Display 400 only.

headline.purpose: App page titles and onboarding card titles, DM Serif Display 400 only.

title.purpose: Route stop names on the desktop login rail, Inter 600.

body.purpose: Inter for all copy, data and numbers.

label.purpose: Inter 500 for labels, nav items, buttons.

label-caps.purpose: The 'You are here' stop badge only.

motion.name: login-halo
motion.purpose: The login's one motion moment: a 0 to 12px halo in rgba(66,166,53,0.6 to 0) from the current route stop, twice. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: login: larger heading (3rem), wider band padding

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: app rail appears (56px icon-only); mobile top bar hidden

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: app rail widens to 224px with labels; login splits into a 40% olive rail with the vertical route beside a white sign-in column

scope.purpose: Advisor-app fixes tokens cannot express live under body.aim-brand; the rail and login route are unscoped so the olive paints before AimBrandScope mounts. Palette tokens are global in packages/config/theme/tokens.css.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every primary action: New, Continue when no Google button is shown.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--cal-brand, #2b7a24); color: var(--cal-brand-text, #ffffff); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cal-brand-emphasis, #22631c); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42a635; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Google Sign-in Button
components.description: The advisor's way in on the login: primary green, 48px, colored Google mark.
components.css: .ds-btn-google { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 48px; background: var(--cal-brand, #2b7a24); color: var(--cal-brand-text, #ffffff); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-google:hover { background: var(--cal-brand-emphasis, #22631c); } .ds-btn-google:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42a635; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Connect, and the login's Continue whenever Google is shown, so one primary action leads.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--cal-bg, #ffffff); color: var(--cal-text, #1d2419); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--cal-border, #82927c); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--cal-bg-muted, #f7faf5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42a635; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields: white ground, sage stroke, brand-green caret, focus-green ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cal-text, #1d2419); } .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--cal-bg, #ffffff); color: var(--cal-text, #1d2419); border: 1px solid var(--cal-border, #82927c); border-radius: 12px; caret-color: var(--cal-brand, #2b7a24); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(66,166,53,0.35); border-color: #42a635; }

components.name: AIM Staff Divider
components.description: Separates Google sign-in from the staff email form; shown only with a social button.
components.css: .ds-staff-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin: 28px 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-staff-divider span { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--cal-border-subtle, #dfe7db); } .ds-staff-divider em { font-style: normal; font-size: 14px; color: var(--cal-text-muted, #5a6655); }

components.name: Login Route
components.description: Signature: the three stops of a first login on the olive rail, current stop filled with one halo moment.
components.html:
1. 1Sign in You are here

    With the Google account Annuity Gator set up for you.

  2. 2Check your calendar

    It's already connected. Choose which calendars to check for conflicts.

  3. 3Connect Zoom or Google Meet

    Every appointment gets its own meeting link.
components.css: .ds-route { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 40px 56px; background: #1f3d1b; display: grid; gap: 40px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stop { position: relative; padding-left: 48px; } .ds-stop:not(:last-child)::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 28px; bottom: -40px; width: 2px; background: #3d6a37; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 28px; height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #6fca60; background: #1f3d1b; color: #bdd3b6; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dot-current { border-color: #42a635; background: #42a635; color: #0d150b; animation: ds-here 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 0.3s 2; } .ds-stop strong { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-here { background: #e2f2dc; color: #1f3d1b; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-stop p { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 22rem; color: #bdd3b6; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.375; } @keyframes ds-here { from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(66,166,53,0.6); } to { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(66,166,53,0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot-current { animation: none; } }

components.name: Olive Rail
components.description: The app sidebar: olive ground, cream labels, translucent cream hover and active.

components.css: .ds-rail { background: #1f3d1b; width: 224px; padding: 16px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-rail-item { color: #e2f2dc; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(226,242,220,0.1); color: #ffffff; } .ds-rail-item.ds-active { background: rgba(226,242,220,0.18); color: #ffffff; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42a635; } .ds-rail-credit { margin-top: 24px; font-size: 10px; color: #bdd3b6; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: On is brand green; off is the honest sage track, never a brand tint.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-block; position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--cal-brand, #2b7a24); vertical-align: middle; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 18px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; transition: left .15s; } .ds-switch.ds-off { background: #7f8f79; } .ds-switch.ds-off::after { left: 2px; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #42a635; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
cal's screens, re-dressed in the Annuity Gator funnel identity (quiz.annuitygator.com) that advisors and prospects already trust. The whole app speaks one brand: palette, heading face, wordmark, and one signature region, the olive rail. Advisors meet that rail at the door: the login is an olive rail carrying the route in (sign in, check your calendar, connect Zoom or Google Meet) beside a plain white sign-in column, and the same rail runs down the side of the app once they are inside. The neutral blue-gray SaaS look is refused, and so is the centered card on a flat ground for the login.

The theme has two layers:

1. **Global tokens** in `packages/config/theme/tokens.css` (`:root` for light, `.dark` for dark) and fonts in `apps/web/app/fonts.ts` (Inter as `--font-sans`, DM Serif Display as `--font-cal`). Every surface, public booking pages included, reads these. `--ag-brand`, `--ag-brand-emphasis` and `--ag-brand-text` hold the brand per theme.
2. **Advisor-app fixes** in `apps/web/styles/aim-brand.css`. Most rules sit under `body.aim-brand`, a class `AimBrandScope` (`apps/web/components/aim/AimBrandScope.tsx`) adds while an advisor-facing screen is mounted (app shell, login, auth error, onboarding); it sits on `<body>` so portalled menus and dialogs inherit it. They hold only what tokens cannot express: the coss-ui token family, stock markup that hard-codes grays, the off switch and text selection. The olive rail (`.aim-rail`) and the login route (`.aim-login-*`) are deliberately **not** scoped to `body.aim-brand`: `AimBrandScope` adds its class after mount, and the olive ground must be there on first paint or the cream wordmark sits on a light ground.

Runtime brand colors (`useAppTheme` on `<html>`, an advisor's `brandColor`) are overridden by pinning `--cal-brand*` to `--ag-brand*`: on `<body>` in the advisor app, and on the booking wrapper through `BOOKING_BRAND_VARS` (`apps/web/modules/bookings/lib/booking-brand.ts`).
keyCharacteristics: Token remap, not component rewrite: `--cal-*` tokens are global; coss-ui tokens (`--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--ring`, `--border`, `--input`, `--muted-foreground`, `--foreground`) point at them inside the advisor scope.
Brand green on every primary action, focus ring, selection, caret and native accent.
Olive rail on the left (the app sidebar, and the login's route rail); content on white. Sage grounds stay on onboarding and the auth utility pages (error, forgot password, logout).
DM Serif Display for headings only; Inter for everything else.
The Annuity Gator wordmark and arrow-A mark, used as supplied.

rules.name: The One Source Rule
rules.body: Every palette value lives in `packages/config/theme/tokens.css`, light and dark. `aim-brand.css` may reference tokens but never declares a new palette value, except the olive rail (including the login route drawn on it: connector #3d6a37, stop rings #6fca60, current stop #42a635 with #0d150b numeral, "You are here" pill #e2f2dc on #1f3d1b ink, and the current stop's halo in the same green), the off-switch track, and text selection.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: No text on a light ground goes below text-muted. Stock cal markup that hard-codes `text-gray-400` / `text-zinc-400` (2.6:1 on white) is remapped to `--cal-text-muted` inside the advisor scope.

rules.name: The Honest Off Rule
rules.body: An unchecked switch uses switch-off-track `#7f8f79` (3.4:1 on white), never a brand tint, so a hidden event type cannot read as half-on.

rules.name: The Green Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark theme uses olive-black grounds derived from the funnel greens, never pure black or cal's grays: ground #11180f, muted #18221a, subtle #1f2c1d, emphasis #283826; text #e6eee2, headings #f3f8ef, subtle #a4b49f, muted #94a38f (4.69:1 or better on every dark ground); field strokes #5b7055 (3.35:1). Primary actions are #4cae3e with near-black #0d150b text (6.58:1), hover #5cc04d; white text never sits on the dark-theme green.

rules.name: The Headings-Only Serif Rule
rules.body: The serif enters only through `--font-cal` (the `font-cal` utility). Body, labels, data and numbers stay on Inter.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display ships a single weight (400). Never pair `font-cal` with a bold or semibold weight; the browser fakes it. `tokens.css` pins `.font-cal` to 400 with `font-synthesis: none`, so stock cal markup that asks for semibold still renders the real face.

rules.name: The One Moment Rule
rules.body: The login has exactly one motion moment: a halo that grows from the current stop to 12px and fades, twice (1.6s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 0.3s delay). `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` turns it off.

rules.name: The AIM Staff Divider Rule
rules.body: Advisors sign in with Google; the email and password form below is for AIM staff, introduced by a hairline divider labelled "AIM staff" in text-muted (28px above and below). It appears only when a social sign-in button is shown.

dos: **Do** add new palette values to `packages/config/theme/tokens.css` in both `:root` and `.dark`, and mount `AimBrandScope` on any new advisor-facing screen.
**Do** map both token families (`--cal-*` and coss-ui) when a new token is needed; coss-ui components ignore `--cal-*`.
**Do** use brand-green for every primary action and text-muted as the floor for light-ground text.
**Do** use the light wordmark on olive and the dark wordmark on white or sage.
**Do** keep `.aim-rail` and the login route rules outside `body.aim-brand`, so the olive paints before `AimBrandScope` mounts.
**Do** keep one primary action per auth screen: when Google is shown, Continue drops to outline.
**Do** put every login string through `t()` with English and Spanish entries.
donts: **Don't** declare palette values outside `tokens.css`, or let a runtime brand color (advisor `brandColor`, `useAppTheme`) reach a brand surface unpinned.
**Don't** set a heading in the serif at any weight other than 400.
**Don't** give an off switch or disabled control a brand tint.
**Don't** recolor, redraw or substitute the Annuity Gator wordmark.
**Don't** spread olive beyond the rail; content stays on white, and sage grounds stay on onboarding and the auth utility pages.
**Don't** put the login back in a centered card on a flat ground.
**Don't** add a second motion moment to the login, or run the halo under reduced motion.
